description: AI-assisted voice and audiobook recording studio (呱呱有声录音宝)
##: The vendor only serves a ZIP whose sole useful entry is the NSIS setup exe '【win安装包】呱呱有声录音宝_setup_1.5.4.exe' nested under a version folder; the bundled JPG manuals are discarded.

The zip is extracted by Scoop first; installer.script then expands the NSIS setup exe as 7z and expands its embedded $PLUGINSDIR\app-64.7z into $dir, which yields the flat Electron payload with 呱呱有声录音宝.exe at the root.
Only a Windows x64 build exists (app-64.7z), so the manifest is 64-bit only.
checkver scrapes the server-rendered __NUXT__ state on the recording page for winDownloadAddress; there is no version API or published checksum.
autoupdate.hash is omitted: the vendor publishes no SHA-256/MD5, so Excavator downloads the ZIP to recompute the hash.
The version folder and setup exe name both embed the version, so installer.script locates them with wildcards instead of hardcoding 1.5.4.
notes: The JPG usage guides shipped inside the vendor ZIP are not installed; only the recorder application is.
